propositions: Add a `--retry` CLI override to resume the literal latest eligible INDETERMINATE review, reusing successful/resumed units from the discovery journal and calling only failed/cancelled/shed units under a fresh per-invocation attempt budget.

A retry operation must refuse (exit 2, no model calls) if the latest result is not INDETERMINATE, its journal is missing/stale/corrupt/legacy/digest-mismatched, or material/policy/prompts/contracts/model/mode/topology/context/dependencies/source have changed since checkpoint creation.

Reconstruct each reusable unit's checkpoint_identity digest from current ticket context and reload findings via sizing.load_checkpoint; treat units with changed digest or missing envelope as missing and re-run.

Assemble final verdict from combined reused findings plus newly recovered work; rerun pass-2 verification/coaching only for newly recovered findings, and rerun deterministic decision/assembly/signature over the full combined result.
`--retry` is mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; compatible with `--no-sign`; cumulative lineage spend is audit-recorded but never enforced as a cap.

Document retry eligibility, fresh budget, reuse/refusal behavior, flag conflicts, signing, and full-review remedy in canonical help, CLI reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-codes guide.
